description: This is a Java source file containing integration tests for Recurring Deposit functionality in the Apache Fineract project. It includes tests for account creation, approval, activation, interest posting, premature closure with different closure types, updating account details, approval and undo approval, rejection, withdrawal, from various perspectives such as withhold tax and different closure methods.

classes.name: RecurringDepositTest
classes.description: A series of integration tests for recurring deposit functionalities such as creation, approval, activation, interest posting, premature closure with various closure types, updating, approval/undo approval, rejection, withdrawal, and handling of withhold tax in the Apache Fineract project.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST assured configuration, request/response specifications, and sets default timezone.

methods.name: testRecurringDepositAccountWithPrematureClosureTypeWithdrawal
methods.description: Tests premature closure of a recurring deposit account with withdrawal closure type and cash-based accounting.

methods.name: testRecurringDepositAccountWithPrematureClosureTypeTransferToSavings
methods.description: Tests premature closure of a recurring deposit account with transfer to savings closure type and cash-based accounting.

methods.name: testRecurringDepositAccountWithPrematureClosureTypeTransferToSavings_WITH_HOLD_TAX
methods.description: Tests premature closure with transfer to savings, including withhold tax handling.

methods.name: testRecurringDepositAccountWithClosureTypeTransferToSavings_WITH_HOLD_TAX
methods.description: Tests closure with transfer to savings including withhold tax, with account maturity and balance verification.

methods.name: testRecurringDepositAccountWithPrematureClosureTypeReinvest
methods.description: Tests premature closure of a recurring deposit account with reinvest closure type, expecting validation error for unsupported reinvest closure.

methods.name: testRecurringDepositAccountUpdation
methods.description: Tests updating the details of an existing recurring deposit account.

methods.name: testRecurringDepositAccountUndoApproval
methods.description: Tests the workflow for approving and then undoing approval of a recurring deposit account.

methods.name: testRecurringDepositAccountRejectedAndClosed
methods.description: Tests rejection and closure of a recurring deposit application.

methods.name: testRecurringDepositAccountWithdrawnByClientAndClosed
methods.description: Tests withdrawal by client and subsequent closure of a recurring deposit account.

methods.name: createRecurringDepositProduct
methods.description: Creates a new recurring deposit product with specified parameters and optional charts.

methods.name: createRecurringDepositProductWithWithHoldTax
methods.description: Creates a new recurring deposit product with withhold tax configuration.

methods.name: createRecurringDepositProduct
methods.description: Creates a new recurring deposit product with specified period and range charts, accounting rules, and optional chart type.

methods.name: applyForRecurringDepositApplication
methods.description: Submits a new recurring deposit application for a given client and product with specified dates and deposit details.

methods.name: applyForRecurringDepositApplication
methods.description: Overloaded method to submit application with deposit amount and period details.

methods.name: createSavingsProduct
methods.description: Creates a savings product with specified interest and minimum balance rules.

methods.name: getMappedLiabilityFinancialAccount
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a liability financial account mapping for account transfers.

methods.name: createLiabilityFinancialAccountTransferType
methods.description: Creates a liability financial account for transfer types.

methods.name: assertFinancialActivityAccountCreation
methods.description: Verifies creation of a financial activity account mapping.

methods.name: createTaxGroup
methods.description: Creates a tax group with specified percentage and liability account.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Deletes all financial activity accounts after each test to clean up.
